desc: [**Higanzakura**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prunus_itosakura) is a particular breed of sakura that gets the name from the fact that it blooms around mid-March, right around the spring equinox when [**Higan**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Higan) is held. And you know, Higan is... 🤨 huh, it actually is like enlightenment, but here in Touhou it's just the other side of the Sanzu River?
